why.terrace: San Mamés is loud and committed; ultras group Herri Norte known in Spain, not a world-famous end
why.city: Bilbao and Basque identity are bound to the club
why.voice: Member-owned, members elect the president; not a sports corporation
why.conscience: Nothing notable found at San Mamés; Basque-only cantera and community foundation, players targeted away (Williams, Sannadi)
why.ground: New San Mamés (2013), 53,289, the 'cathedral', usually near full
why.contender: Copa del Rey 2024, Supercopas 2015 and 2021, Europa League final 2012; 12th in 2025-26
why.rituals: Basque-only player policy, gabarra river celebration, 'Lehoiak'; known well beyond Spain

why.women: Athletic Club Femenino: five league titles, Liga F, 4th in 2024-25
why.intensity: Valverde-era high press and wing speed (Williams brothers); Edin Terzić now coach

why.contender: Copa del Rey 2019, final 2022; mid-table since (9th in 2025-26)

why.women: Valencia Femenino relegated from Liga F in 2025, promoted back for 2026-27
why.intensity: Estimate: pragmatic, low-possession sides under recent coaches (Javier Aguirre now)

why.terrace: Ultras group Iraultza 1921 (left-wing), loud but small

why.women: Las Gloriosas won Primera Federación, back in Liga F for 2026-27
